chapters.label: The final, live
chapters.text: Gothenburg, 2021: the Champions League final, Barcelona against Chelsea. Here's how Mapi León defends. Chelsea attack. Mapi steps in and wins the ball. Head up... long pass!

chapters.label: Stay on your feet
chapters.text: Watch again. She doesn't dive in. She stays on her feet, then pokes the ball away with her left foot. Clean!

chapters.label: Head up, look far
chapters.text: Her head comes up. She spots a teammate far away, and the long pass flies over Chelsea's attack. Barcelona won that final four nil!

chapters.label: The secret
chapters.text: The secret? Win the ball cleanly. Then lift your head, and find a teammate far away.
